start: Today, card 'Joined online', the cases that must refuse

steps.action: Approve a person whose plan the gym stopped selling
user_sees: 'The plan they picked is no longer sold. Tap Make member and pick a plan.'
must_not: A member on a plan that is not sold
A receipt with no plan

steps.action: Approve a payment that was refunded meanwhile
user_sees: 'This online payment was refunded, so nothing was saved. Ask them how they will pay.'
must_not: A member and a receipt for refunded money

steps.action: Look at a row paid in the payment company’s test mode
user_sees: '₹<total> paid in test mode · No real money came in · Collect it at the desk'
'Approve makes them a member with their plan. Nothing is saved as paid.'
must_not: A receipt for test money

steps.action: Look at a row that paid a different amount than the plan
user_sees: '₹<paid> paid online, but the plan is ₹<total> · Check before approving'
On Approve: '<name> paid ₹<paid>, but the plan is ₹<total>. Approve saves ₹<paid> as paid; the rest stays due.'
must_not: The full plan marked paid

steps.action: Look at rows where the online payment failed or was left
user_sees: '₹<total> · The online payment did not go through · Not paid'
'₹<total> · Started paying online, did not finish · Not paid'
must_not: Approve offered for either

steps.action: Tap 'Make member' on a person who pays online in that same moment
user_sees: '<name> has just paid online. Tap Approve instead.'
must_not: The fee collected at the desk and online for the same plan

start: Today as front desk staff, card 'Joined online'

steps.action: Tap Approve while the owner approves the same person on another device
user_sees: 'Someone else at the desk is approving this person now. Wait a minute and look again.'
must_not: Two members or two receipts

steps.action: Tap Approve with the internet off
user_sees: 'Could not approve. Check your internet and try again.'
must_not: A member saved on the device with no receipt on the server

steps.action: Tap 'Make member' when the open online payment cannot be checked
user_sees: 'Could not check their online payment. Check your internet and try again.'
must_not: The form opening while an online payment may still land

steps.action: Approve a request whose name or number cannot be saved
user_sees: 'Their name or number could not be saved. Tap Make member to check them.'
must_not: A member with a broken number

user_sees: The same person as a joined enquiry
must_not: The request listed as still open

steps.action: Tap 'Approve' twice fast on a paid request
user_sees: One member, one plan, one receipt
must_not: A second receipt for the same online payment

steps.action: Leave a request waiting until after the start day they picked, then make them a member
user_sees: The plan starts on the usual day (today), not on the passed day
